title: Big Data Engineer Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on distributed systems, SQL, Python, data pipelines, Spark, streaming, cloud platforms, data warehouses and large-scale data processing.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. Years 1–2 build programming, databases and computer-science fundamentals; Years 3–4 progressively add distributed computing, Spark, streaming, cloud data platforms, orchestration and production-grade data systems.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move from building individual pipelines to designing distributed data platforms. Build depth in streaming, data contracts, governance, observability, security, cloud economics and the infrastructure required by AI/ML systems.

PhD routes

Move from implementing large-scale pipelines to designing resilient data platforms. Develop expertise in distributed computing, streaming, governance, privacy, observability, reliability and cloud economics. AI infrastructure and large-scale model workloads also make strong data-platform fundamentals increasingly relevant.
